g.text: PD15 / U1 pin62 is a regular FT_h GPIO input. PA9 remains NC. D+/D- are unchanged.

g.desc: PD15 / U1 pin62 is a regular FT_h GPIO input. PA9 remains NC. D+/D- are unchanged.

g.text: R9=6.2k 1%, R110=10k 0.1%; TP92 measures their junction. No internal pull-up/down.

g.desc: R9=6.2k 1%, R110=10k 0.1%; TP92 measures their junction. No internal pull-up/down.

g.text: Input range and tolerance calculation uses DS12110 Rev11, Tables14/112 and50/147.

g.desc: Input range and tolerance calculation uses DS12110 Rev11, Tables14/112 and50/147.

g.text: Use software attach/detach from PD15. Do NOT enable native PA9 VBUS sensing (VBDEN).

g.desc: Use software attach/detach from PD15. Do NOT enable native PA9 VBUS sensing (VBDEN).

g.text: USB 48MHz source, descriptors, suspend current and actual enumeration remain unqualified.

g.text: VBUS decay depends on C28/C83/C86 and mux/switch leakage. RC estimates are conditional.

g.text: Measure reset/unpowered input, USB plug/unplug, discharge and hot leakage before acceptance.
